method: Sequentially replace only the target source, build the canonical Ninja object target, and run objdiff against the retail split. Patches are relative to the base source. Identical disassembly outputs are deduplicated here; final raw canonical and strict objdiff are separate evidence files.
hypotheses: Commutative operand order can change register coalescing and instruction scheduling.
Aggregate scalar replacement can give the radius and coordinates different allocation priorities.
Short coordinate locals can separate loaded coordinates from truncated output bounds without changing stored values.
Function/enclosing scope can change allocation priority across the loop boundary.
A specific liveness-based local order may assign x and y0 to one register while separating radius.
